Kimberly — reviewed the pack. Finance can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding under these conditions:

1) Trade reference or bank confirmation (one of the following): bank ACH test or reference contact (name + phone)
2) Remit instructions + PO field left blank on invoices; invoices to include Redwood-specific billing code
3) Net 30 invoices only; auto-suspend if unpaid >45 days
4) Legal sign-off on the one-page addendum limiting liability and defining the 90-day pilot cap

If Procurely can provide the bank confirmation and sign the addendum, Finance will mark APPROVED in our procurement system for the 90-day period and $15k cap. Otherwise we require a PO.

Danny Patel
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
